DECISION.caveat: HARD x LARGE has only 2 problems: the LARGE-space stratum is under-populated. The wrong-answer space is small here not by convergence but by SPARSITY — mean m_wrong ~2.7/10 agents, and when >=2 err they mostly DISAGREE (median Simpson 0). So Route 2 is blocked by OUTPUT-SPACE STRUCTURE (few, diverse errors), not by the independence mechanism failing — a different, more fundamental obstruction. Read the decision as provisional. ALSO: the M1 same-model-samples arm was entirely lost to OpenRouter 402 (out of credits), so Delta = excess(M1) - excess(M3) cannot be formed from real data — the preregistered LIVE/MIRAGE/CLOSED rule is UNREACHABLE regardless of the stratum. This is an external data-loss blocker, not a scientific null.
